prompt: How do I list the accounts my customers have linked in StackOne? Show me the request and explain the fields that come back on each account.
skill_note: Listing linked accounts is a platform question, so the skill should fire.

no_fetch.name: avoids-v1-accounts-reference
no_fetch.note: The agent never fetches the uncatalogued v1 accounts reference. The v2 URL has `/v2/` between `api-reference` and `accounts`, so it does not match this pattern.

reply.name: uses-v2-accounts-endpoint
reply.note: The reply shows the v2 accounts endpoint, which is the only one the docs catalogue.

reply.name: names-connector-field
reply.note: The reply names the `connector` field. The v1 reference called it `provider`.

reply.name: names-owner-id-field
reply.note: The reply names the `owner_id` field. The v1 reference called it `origin_owner_id`.

no_reply.name: no-legacy-field-names
no_reply.note: The reply does not use the retired `origin_owner_id` field name.
